content.short: OMI Group provides bridges between virtual worlds by exploring interoperable identity, social graphs, and inventory.
content.description: OMI Group is an open-source community that brings together industry professionals, independent creators, and passionate metaverse enthusiasts to collaboratively build interoperable technology in the open. The project invites users to support the effort by donating toward building an open metaverse. Developers can join the GitHub contributions list and add code, stories, and worlds to the project, helping expand its scope and foster a growing network of collaborators. By operating openly, the group encourages transparent participation and shared ownership as its work progresses.
